text_block_list.text:
After arriving at the cafeteria for lunch, I
notice
Юкино Бидзин staring
absentmindedly at the menu.
choice_data_list:
You're really burning a hole into that menu
there.

text_block_list.text: Huh?! That's not what I'm try'n to do!
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
There's an extra large soba on the menu
for a
limited time only, and it r'minded
me of the
wanko soba back home...
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text: Did you say... wanko soba?!
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: If I remember correctly, you're from Morioka, right? The birthplace of wanko soba... Gulp...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп
choice_data_list: (She looks like she's about to explode...)

text_block_list.text: Cool it, Oguri! You're scarin' 'em!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I just can't stop thinking about
wanko
soba... Could you tell me more
about the real
deal?
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Gee whillikers, sure... But I'm no
afici'nado, mind
you. I've only ever been
on refill duty.
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин
choice_data_list:
Refill duty? You mean dishing out more noodles
each time the customer's bowl is empty?

text_block_list.text:
Righty-roo! It's quite fun. You pour in a
bite-sized
serving of soba and say
"heeere ya go" or "heeere
it comes."
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
I wasn't great at the start, so the lady at
the
restaurant had to keep helping me
out.
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
That's all fascinating... So, Yukino, if I
ask you for
some wanko soba, will you
serve some up?
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
As if, ya doink head! She just said she
was only a
refiller!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I can't make it m'self, but the
wanko soba
from Morioka's really tasty!
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
We've got lotsa other foods 'n fun things
too, so
you should definitely visit!
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин
choice_data_list: Now I want some wanko soba too.

text_block_list.text:
We've got lotsa other foods 'n fun things
too, so
you should definitely visit!
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин
choice_data_list: Now I want some wanko soba too.

text_block_list.text:
Well, let's see... There's a famous festival
called
the Morioka Sansa Odori.
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
It's got taiko drums, flutes, and people
danc'n
down the street in a p'rade!
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин
choice_data_list: That must take a heck of a lot of prep work.

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but all that prep made for a darn
good
workout, so I actually  enjoyed it!
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
Everyone in town treated me super
kindly, like I
was their granddaughter. It
was a lotta fun help'n
out with the
preparations!
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
Sounds like a real nice place. Is that
what your
hometown's like too, Oguri?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I remember when Tome and the
others
taught me the Kasamatsu Ondo
dance... I hope
everyone's doing okay.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
I miss my hometown too... Maybe I'll
write
ever'one sometime.
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
I want to send a letter filled with good
news, so
I'll hafta train hard!
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
Same. But to train hard, first I have to
sufficiently
fill my belly.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Their love for their hometowns helps
motivate
them to train harder.
What a coincidence! Me too!
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Oh, there's a wanko soba rest'rant round
here.
D'ya want me to take ya there?
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
It's owned by the lady who showed me
the ropes
as a refiller back home, so I
can vouch for the
qual'ty and flavors!
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
Mmm! Jinkies, her soba always hits the
spot!
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I could go on eating this
forever...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... So this is what authentic wanko
soba
tastes like.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Oh, looks like you're runn'n short on
refills.
Wouldja like me to lend a hand
with the serving?
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
Wouldja, Yukino? I know you're here as
a
customer 'n all, but...
text_block_list.name: Older Shopkeeper Lady

text_block_list.text: Sure! Leave the refill'n to me!
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text: Heeere ya go! Heeere it comes!
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
I swear, Oguri, you've got a black hole in
place of
your stomach. I know it's
all-you-can-eat here,
but go easy on
'em, will ya?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
S'no problem at all! Seeing my customers
eat'n
plenty and leav'n satisfied is what
makes me
happy.
text_block_list.name: Older Shopkeeper Lady

text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Yukino! Why, you're a bona fide
refill'r
now!
text_block_list.name: Older Shopkeeper Lady

text_block_list.text:
You use to be just a tiny kid carry'n
around the
serv'n tray. Everyone'd be so
worried watch'n ya.
text_block_list.name: Older Shopkeeper Lady

text_block_list.text: Awww, c'mon now! Shucks.
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
I'm made doubly aware of this once
when I hear
Oguri Cap's stomach
grumbling.

Юкино Бидзин continues refilling Oguri
Cap's bowl
until she's full... I guess this
ended up being a
good training session
for everyone.
